report_name: Fake Indian Gov't Job Postings Spread 'SheetAgent' RAT via Google Sheets

attack_patterns.name: Malicious File
attack_patterns.description: The attack initiates when a victim opens a malicious LNK shortcut file disguised as a recruitment notice within a ZIP archive.

attack_patterns.name: PowerShell
attack_patterns.description: A malicious LNK file executes a hidden PowerShell script to deploy the SheetAgent RAT payload.

attack_patterns.name: Dead Drop Resolver
attack_patterns.description: SheetAgent uses the Google Sheets API to communicate with an attacker-controlled spreadsheet to retrieve C2 information and commands.

attack_patterns.name: Web Protocols
attack_patterns.description: The malware uses Google Sheets API calls for C2, making the traffic appear as legitimate web protocol communications to evade network defenses.

attack_patterns.name: Remote Access Software
attack_patterns.description: The attackers were observed using the legitimate ControlR remote management platform during the attack chain.

malware.name: SheetAgent
malware.description: A new .NET-based Remote Access Trojan (RAT) that uses Google Sheets as a novel backup command-and-control channel.

tools.name: ControlR
tools.description: The legitimate ControlR remote management platform was abused by the attackers during the infection chain.

campaigns.name: Operation ShadowRecruit
campaigns.description: A targeted malware campaign in India using fake government job postings to distribute the SheetAgent RAT to job seekers.

identities.name: Indian Cabinet Secretariat
identities.description: Used as a lure in the campaign. The attackers created a fake recruitment notice for a 'Senior Field Officer' role in this organization to trick victims.

identities.name: Seqrite
identities.description: The enterprise security company that discovered and reported on the Operation ShadowRecruit campaign.

infrastructure.name: Google Sheets C2 Channel
infrastructure.description: SheetAgent malware uses an attacker-controlled Google Sheet as a fallback C2 channel, reading commands from and writing data to specific cells via the Google Sheets API.

indicators.name: SheetAgent C2 Traffic to Google Sheets
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: SheetAgent C2 Traffic to Google Sheets
id: 7c5b1a3d-8f9e-4b1c-9a2d-3e4f5a6b7c8d
status: experimental
description: Detects DNS queries to sheets.googleapis.com from unusual processes, which could indicate C2 communication by the SheetAgent RAT.
references:
  - https://www.itvoice.in/seqrite-uncovers-operation-shadowrecruit-fake-recruitment-campaign-targets-indian-job-seekers-with-multi-stage-malware
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-20
tags:
  - attack.t1102.001
  - attack.t1071.001
  - attack.command_and_control
level: medium
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate applications using the Google Sheets API.
logsource:
  category: dns_query
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    QueryName: 'sheets.googleapis.com'
  filter:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\chrome.exe'
      - '\firefox.exe'
      - '\msedge.exe'
      - '\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe'
  condition: selection and not filter
indicators.description: Detects network traffic to sheets.googleapis.com from processes other than web browsers, a TTP used by SheetAgent for C2.

indicators.name: ShadowRecruit Malicious LNK File Creation
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: ShadowRecruit Malicious LNK File Creation
id: 1a2b3c4d-5e6f-4a9b-8c7d-6e5f4a3b2c1d
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of a malicious LNK file used in the Operation ShadowRecruit campaign.
references:
  - https://www.itvoice.in/seqrite-uncovers-operation-shadowrecruit-fake-recruitment-campaign-targets-indian-job-seekers-with-multi-stage-malware
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-20
tags:
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.initial_access
level: high
falsepositives:
  - None expected.
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '\Cabinet Secretariat Recruitment.lnk'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the presence of the malicious LNK file used as the initial vector in Operation ShadowRecruit.

indicators.name: Suspicious ControlR Execution
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: Suspicious ControlR Execution
id: f9e8d7c6-b5a4-4938-8271-d6c5b4a3e2f1
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of ControlR.exe, a legitimate remote management tool observed being abused in the Operation ShadowRecruit campaign.
references:
  - https://www.itvoice.in/seqrite-uncovers-operation-shadowrecruit-fake-recruitment-campaign-targets-indian-job-seekers-with-multi-stage-malware
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-20
tags:
  - attack.t1219
  - attack.execution
level: medium
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate use of ControlR by system administrators.
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\ControlR.exe'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the execution of the ControlR remote management tool, which was abused in this campaign.

indicators.name: ShadowRecruit PowerShell Execution Pattern
indicators.pattern:
title: ShadowRecruit PowerShell Execution Pattern
id: 2b3c4d5e-6f7a-4b8c-9d6e-5f4a3b2c1d0e
status: experimental
description: Detects the PowerShell execution pattern used in Operation ShadowRecruit to deploy the SheetAgent RAT.
references:
  - https://www.itvoice.in/seqrite-uncovers-operation-shadowrecruit-fake-recruitment-campaign-targets-indian-job-seekers-with-multi-stage-malware
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-20
tags:
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.execution
level: high
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate administrative scripts using similar parameters.
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\powershell.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - '-ExecutionPolicy Bypass'
      - '-File'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the specific PowerShell command line pattern used to execute the payload script in the Operation ShadowRecruit campaign.
